_how: PRF state sponsors, read by components/prf-sponsor.js on /prf, /prf/<state> and every county page. One entry per state code, e.g. "IA": {"name": "Business name", "url": "https://...", "line": "One sentence, 120 characters at most.", "logo": "/img/sponsors/name.webp", "through": "2026-12-31"}. logo is optional. The day after through, the state shows its offer again. Checked by test/prf-sponsor.test.mjs.
